verses.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.pt: No ano quinze do império de Tibério César, sendo Pôncio Pilatos o governador da Judeia, Herodes tetraca da Galileia, e seu irmão Filipe o tetrarca da Itureia e da província de Traconites, e Lisânias o tetrarca de Abilene;
verses.en_web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.en_bbe: Now in the fifteenth year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being ruler of Judaea, and Herod being king of Galilee, his brother Philip king of the country of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias king of Abilene,

verses.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.pt: sendo Anás e Caifás os sumos sacerdotes, a palavra de Deus veio a João, filho de Zacarias, no deserto.
verses.en_web: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: When Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of the Lord came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the waste land.

verses.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
verses.pt: Ele percorreu toda a região ao redor do Jordão, pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para o perdão dos pecados;
verses.en_web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
verses.en_bbe: And he came into all the country round about Jordan, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.

verses.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.pt: conforme o que está escrito no livro das palavras do profeta Isaías, que diz: “Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas.
verses.en_web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
verses.en_bbe: As it says in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

verses.en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
verses.pt: Todo vale se encherá, e todo monte e colina se abaixará; os tortos serão endireitados, e os caminhos ásperos se suavizarão;
verses.en_web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
verses.en_bbe: Every valley will be lifted up, and all the mountains and hills made low, and the twisted will be made straight, and the rough ways smooth;

verses.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.pt: e todos verão a salvação de Deus.”
verses.en_web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
verses.en_bbe: And all flesh will see the salvation of God.

verses.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.pt: João dizia às multidões que vinham ser batizadas por ele: “Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira que está para chegar?
verses.en_web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.en_bbe: So he said to the people who went out to him for baptism: You offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.pt: Dai, pois, frutos condizentes com o arrependimento, e não comeceis a dizer em vós mesmos: ‘Temos Abraão por pai’; pois eu vos digo que até destas pedras Deus pode produzir filhos a Abraão.
verses.en_web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
verses.en_bbe: Make clear by your acts that your hearts have been changed; and do not say to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father: for I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children of Abraham.

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.pt: E também o machado já está posto à raiz das árvores; portanto, toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.
verses.en_web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”
verses.en_bbe: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; and every tree which does not have good fruit will be cut down and put into the fire.

verses.en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.pt: E as multidões lhe perguntavam: Então o que devemos fazer?
verses.en_web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
verses.en_bbe: And the people put questions to him, saying, What have we to do?

verses.en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.pt: E ele lhes respondeu: Quem tiver duas túnicas, reparta com o não tem; e quem tiver comida, faça da mesma maneira.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
verses.en_bbe: And he made answer and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has not even one; and he who has food, let him do the same.

verses.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.pt: E chegaram também uns publicanos, para serem batizados; e disseram-lhe: Mestre, que devemos fazer?
verses.en_web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
verses.en_bbe: Then tax-farmers came to him for baptism and said to him, Master, what have we to do?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Não exijais mais do que vos está ordenado.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Do not make an attempt to get more money than the right amount.

verses.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.pt: E uns soldados também lhe perguntaram: E nós, que devemos fazer? E ele lhes disse: Não maltrateis nem defraudeis a ninguém; e contentai-vos com vossos salários.
verses.en_web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
verses.en_bbe: And men of the army put questions to him, saying, And what have we to do? And he said to them, Do no violent acts to any man, and do not take anything without right, and let your payment be enough for you.

verses.en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.pt: E, enquanto o povo estava em expectativa, e todos pensando em seus corações se talvez João seria o Cristo,
verses.en_web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
verses.en_bbe: And while the people were waiting, and all men were questioning in their hearts about John, if he was the Christ or not,

verses.en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.pt: João respondeu a todos: De fato, eu vos batizo com água, mas vem um que é mais poderoso do que eu, de quem eu não sou digno de desatar a tira das sandálias; ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.
verses.en_web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
verses.en_bbe: John made answer, saying to them all, Truly, I give you baptism with water, but one is coming who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit, and with fire:

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.pt: Sua pá está na sua mão, e limpará sua eira, e juntará o trigo no seu celeiro; porém queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.
verses.en_web: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
verses.en_bbe: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned in the fire which will never be put out.

verses.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.pt: Assim, exortando com muitas outras coisas, João anunciava a boa notícia ao povo.
verses.en_web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
verses.en_bbe: And so comforting them with these and other words, he gave the good news to the people;

verses.en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.pt: Porém, quando Herodes, o tetrarca, foi repreendido por ele por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe, e por todas as maldades que Herodes havia feito,
verses.en_web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
verses.en_bbe: But Herod the king, because John had made a protest on account of Herodias, his brother's wife, and other evil things which Herod had done,

verses.en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.pt: acrescentou a todas ainda esta: encarcerou João na prisão.
verses.en_web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.en_bbe: Did this most evil thing of all, and had John shut up in prison.

verses.en: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando todo o povo era batizado, Jesus também foi batizado, e enquanto orava, o céu se abriu,
verses.en_web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,
verses.en_bbe: Now it came about that when all the people had been given baptism, Jesus, having had baptism with them, was in prayer, when, the heaven being open,

verses.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.pt: e o Espírito Santo desceu sobre ele em forma corpórea, como pomba; e veio do céu uma voz que dizia: Tu és o meu Filho amado, em ti me agrado.
verses.en_web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
verses.en_bbe: The Holy Spirit came down in the form of a dove, and a voice came from heaven, saying, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

verses.en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
verses.pt: E o mesmo Jesus começou quando tinha cerca de trinta anos, sendo (como se pensava) filho de José, filho de Eli,
verses.en_web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus at this time was about thirty years old, being the son (as it seemed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

verses.en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
verses.pt: filho de Matate, filho de Levi, filho de Melqui, filho de Janai, filho de José.
verses.en_web: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

verses.en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
verses.pt: filho de Matatias, filho de Amós, filho de Naum, filho de Esli, filho de Nagai.
verses.en_web: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

verses.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
verses.pt: filho de Maate, filho de Matatias, filho de Semei, filho de José, filho de Judá.
verses.en_web: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,

verses.en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
verses.pt: filho de Joaná, filho de Resa, filho de Zorobabel, e filho de Salatiel, filho de Neri.
verses.en_web: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

verses.en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
verses.pt: filho de Melqui, filho de Adi, e filho de Cosã, filho de Elmodã, filho de Er.
verses.en_web: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

verses.en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
verses.pt: filho de José, filho de Eliézer, filho de Jorim, filho de Matate, filho de Levi.
verses.en_web: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Jesus, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

verses.en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
verses.pt: filho de Simeão, filho de Judá, filho de José, filho de Jonã, filho de Eliaquim.
verses.en_web: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Symeon, the son of Judas, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

verses.en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
verses.pt: filho de Meleá, filho de Mainã, filho de Matatá, filho de Natã, filho de Davi.
verses.en_web: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

verses.en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
verses.pt: Filho de Jessé, filho de Obede, filho de Boaz, filho de Salmom, filho de Naassom.
verses.en_web: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

verses.en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
verses.pt: Filho de Aminadabe, filho de Arão, filho de Esrom, filho de Peres, filho de Judá.
verses.en_web: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Amminadab, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

verses.en: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
verses.pt: filho de Jacó, filho de Isaque, filho de Abraão, filho de Terá, filho de Naor.
verses.en_web: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

verses.en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
verses.pt: filho de Serugue, filho de Ragaú, filho de Faleque, filho de Éber, filho de Salá.
verses.en_web: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

verses.en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
verses.pt: Filho de Cainã, filho de Arfaxade, filho de Sem, filho de Noé, filho de Lameque.
verses.en_web: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

verses.en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
verses.pt: Filho de Matusalém, filho de Enoque, filho de Jarede, filho de Maleleel, filho de Cainã.
verses.en_web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

verses.en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
verses.pt: filho de Enos, filho de Sete, filho de Adão, e Adão de Deus.
verses.en_web: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
verses.en_bbe: The son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
